news.headline: NVIDIA Expands South Korea AI Push With New Startup Investments
news.summary: NVIDIA partners with Rebellions and SK Telecom to build South Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion and Rebel NPUs.

news.headline: What Is Going on With Akamai Stock on Monday?
news.summary: Akamai stock fell about 6% premarket after announcing a $2.2B convertible notes sale to fund cloud infrastructure, despite landing a massive Anthropic deal.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target on Akamai Technologies
news.summary: Goldman Sachs has lowered its price target for Akamai Technologies, Inc. from $93 to $73.

news.headline: Akamai Technologies Announces Proposed $2.2 Billion Convertible Senior Notes Offering
news.summary: Akamai Technologies, Inc. has proposed an offering of $2.2 billion in aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes, split between notes due in 2028 and 2031.

news.headline: Agilix Labs Awarded AWS Education Equity Initiative Grant
news.summary: Agilix Labs received a grant from the AWS Education Equity Initiative to support the Finder Program in Sierra Leone, utilizing Amazon Web Services' AI and cloud technology.

news.headline: Jabil Announces Strategic Alliance with Amazon Business
news.summary: Jabil Procurement and Supply Chain Services has entered into a strategic alliance with Amazon Business to integrate its services with Amazon's product catalogue and innovation architecture.

news.headline: Amazon Prime Video to Stream 'Jailer 2'
news.summary: Amazon Prime Video announced that the film 'Jailer 2' will be available for streaming starting November 12, 2026.

news.headline: Delta Air Lines Participates in COP31 and CBD COP17
news.summary: Delta Air Lines announced its participation in the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) and the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD COP17).

news.headline: Microsoft Confirms Official WSL Support for CachyOS
news.summary: Microsoft has confirmed that the Arch-based Linux distribution CachyOS is now officially supported on the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
